text:
pagerbot: [ALERT] Security pager — unusual token multiplexing detected. Multiple distinct IPs using same API key hitting /v1/infer. Affected tenant: acme-enterprises. Spike start 04:12 UTC, ~250 req/s. Possible exfil of credentials or leaked key. Logs: https://logs.redwood/abc123. Paging @oncall_sre @sec-eng-amy @sec-ops-jay — please ack and triage.

oncall_sre: Ack — I'm on it. Starting initial triage, collecting request headers and session map.

infra-eli: Pushing WAF blocks for the top 3 offending IPs now: 52.14.23.7, 18.200.99.11, 3.89.45.2. Applying edge block rules.

oncall_sre: Confirmed edge blocks applied, inbound rate dropped to ~12 req/s. Still seeing same API key used across disparate geos. Dumping request metadata to secure bucket.

sec-eng-amy: If key exfil, we should rotate all tokens for tenant acme-enterprises immediately. Jay from sec-ops to own rotation + revoke workflow.

sec-ops-jay: Acknowledged. Running hot-rotation: ```./scripts/rotate-tenant-keys --tenant acme-enterprises --revoke-old --notify-cs``` ETA ~8m. Also issuing short-term TTL enforcement (60s) while we monitor.

product-cs-kevin: Notifying CS and account team. Preparing customer-facing message template. Any confirmed customer-visible failures yet?

oncall_sre: Minimal transient 500s during rotation, read traffic routed to fallback model. Recommend proactive notice to customer — impact low but credentials rotated.

legal-lucy: Please place any potentially PII-containing payloads on legal hold. If logs include personal data we need to escalate preservation and notification processes.

sec-eng-amy: Taking copy of full request payloads to secure bucket "incidents/7067894321" and tagging for legal-hold. Running quick scan for emails/SSN-like patterns.

oncall_sre: Quick grep: ~12 payloads with email-like strings in metadata (likely account emails), no SSN patterns found in samples. Uploading samples to secure ticket (sensitive view only).

infra-eli: Rotation completed: old tenant keys revoked at 04:20 UTC, new keys issued/deployed. Verified service tokens rotated as well.

sec-ops-jay: Monitoring auth logs — no successful auths with revoked keys after 04:20 UTC. Still seeing 401s and reprobes from blocked IPs, likely automated scanners.

pagerbot: Reminder: spin up the incident bridge and follow the security runbook. Template: security-token-exfil.

oncall_sre: Bridge created https://meet.redwood/bridge/7067894321. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/token-exfil. Assigning follow-ups: postmortem owner @infra-eli, customer comms @product-cs-kevin, legal notify @legal-lucy.

product-cs-kevin: Draft ready — brief note about rotated keys and ongoing investigation. Will hold send pending legal sign-off.

sec-eng-amy: Initial root cause looks like a misconfigured staging S3 that contained rotated debug logs earlier this week; possible source of leaked keys. Opening ticket to scrub and harden staging buckets.

oncall_sre: Handoff to night oncall @sre-night at 04:45 UTC. @sre-night please monitor auth replays, watch for traffic >50 req/s and keep bridge open.

sre-night: Ack. I'll own through 12:00 UTC. If we see replays or new successful auths with old tokens, I'll re-escalate.

sec-ops-jay: Creating rotation audit with timestamps and affected token ids, will post link to bridge when ready.

legal-lucy: Received payload samples under legal-hold. Will review and advise on customer notice language by EOD.

product-cs-kevin: Sent preliminary heads-up to AE and CS leads.

oncall_sre: Status update: mitigated (blocked offending IPs, rotated tenant keys). Investigation ongoing into staging bucket exposure. Closing this thread for now; will update with postmortem and scrub ticket: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/7067894321-postmortem when available.
